title: A Reversible shearing DNA-based tension probe for cellular force measurement
protocol: Synthesize two oligonucleotide "bricks", strand I and strand II.
Modify the 5'-end of strand I with a Cy3B dye.
Attach a cyclic RGD peptide (cRGDfK) internally to strand I.
Add a phosphoric acid at the 5'-terminal of strand II.
Introduce a thiol group at the 3'-end of strand II.
Treat thiol modified strand I with TCEP solution.
Conjugate Cy3B-maleimide to the thiol group on strand I.
Incubate the partially formed disulfide bond-reduced DNA solution for 2 hours at room temperature.
Pass the incubated solution through a Micro Bio-Spin P-6 Gel Column equilibrated with conjugation buffer.
Add a 5-fold molar excess of Cy3B-maleimide dissolved in DMSO to strand I-thiol solution.
Incubate the reaction mixture for 2 hours at room temperature.
Separate the DNA-Cy3B conjugate from unreacted Cy3B and by-products using a Micro Bio-Spin P-6 Gel Column equilibrated with ultra-pure water.
Purify the DNA product further using an AQ-C18 column in a reverse phase binary pump HPLC (flow rate 1 mL/min, solvent A: 0.1M TEAA, solvent B: 100% acetonitrile).
Dry the purified product by rotation evaporation.

Prepare the reaction solution for labeling DNA strand I with cRGDfK as follows: 50% DMSO; 0.5 mM ascorbic acid; 0.5 mM Cu-TBTA complex; alkyne-modified DNA strand I-Cy3B; 1.5-fold azide-cRGDfK; 0.2M triethylammonium acetate buffer, pH 7.0.
Vortex the mixture thoroughly.
Keep the mixture at room temperature overnight.
Separate the Cy3B-oligonucleotide-cRGDfK conjugate from unmodified oligonucleotide using denaturing polyacrylamide gel electrophoresis (PAGE) with 8M urea.
Cut the desired band from the gel and mince it.
Extract the product in PBS at 4 °C overnight or use a vortex device to promote diffusion of oligonucleotide out of the gel.
Filter the extracted product through a 0.45 um filter tube to remove gel debris.
Desalt and purify the conjugation using a Micro Bio-Spin P-6 Gel Column equilibrated with PBS.
Mix labeled strand I, strand II, and a template strand in a molar ratio of 1.1:1.1:1.
Heat the mixture to 94 °C for 5 min.
Allow the mixture to naturally cool to room temperature for annealing.
Use T4 DNA ligase to ligate strand I and strand II according to the product manual.
Purify the ligation product of 74 nt using denaturing PAGE.
Extract the purified product in PBS at 4 °C overnight or use a vortex device to promote diffusion.
Filter the extracted product through a 0.45 um filter tube to remove gel debris.
Desalt and purify the final product using a Micro Bio-Spin P-6 Gel Column equilibrated with PBS.
Mix strand III and HS74 in a molar ratio of 1.1:1.
Heat the mixture to 94 °C for 5 min.
Allow the mixture to naturally cool to room temperature for annealing.
Sonicate the glass coverslip in ultrapure water for 10 min.
Sonicate the glass coverslip in ethanol for 10 min.
Repeat sonication steps with water and ethanol three times each.
Dry the coverslip at 80 °C.
Etch the coverslip in piranha solution (3:1 sulfuric acid to hydrogen peroxide) for 40 min or use oxygen plasma (gas pressure: 200 mTorr) for 10 min.
Immerse the hydroxylated coverslip into 1% (3-aminopropyl) triethoxysilane in ethanol and incubate at room temperature for 1 h.
Discard the APTES solution after amination.
Rinse the coverslip with fresh ethanol.
Dry the coverslip under nitrogen.
Prepare the PEGylation solution: mix 5% PEG NHS ester and 0.5% lipoic acid PEG NHS ester in 0.1M sodium bicarbonate, pH 8.5.
Drop 100 μl of the prepared PEGylation solution onto the amine-modified surface of the coverslip.
Cover the drop with another coverslip carefully, ensuring both amine-modified surfaces face the PEG solution.
Incubate the covered setup at 4°C overnight or at room temperature for 2 hours.
Rinse the coverslip thoroughly with ultrapure water after PEGylation.
Add 14 nM Au nanoparticles (5-nm diameter) onto the coverslip and incubate for 30 minutes.
Rinse the coverslip with ultrapure water to remove unbound particles, leaving fixed AuNPs on the surface.
Detach the cells by using pre-warmed trypsin/EDTA solution.
Add 2 volumes of complete medium to inactivate trypsin after cells appear detached.
Disperse the cells by gently pipetting over the cell layer surface and then transfer the cells to the tube, followed by centrifuge at 100-g for 5 min.
Remove the supernatant, gently resuspend the cells with a complete growth medium.
Pipette a drop of the cell solution to a petri dish and check the density of the cells under microscopy.
Assemble the force sensor functioned coverslip into the coverslip cell chamber for live-cell microscopy.
Pipette appropriate volume of the cell solution to the cell chamber.
Incubate the cells in an incubator at 37 °C, 5% CO2.
